licenseCaveat: License caveat (applies to every Georgia-archive-derived, Rumsey, and NGE source in this file). Quoted from docs/historical-research/issue-1-newberry-audit.md via issue-3-source-map.md: "The strongest open statement is the Download pages' "reused for any lawful purpose, commercial or non-commercial, without licensing or permission fees to the library" together with the instruction that files containing "the original, out-of-date copyright license … can be ignored". That is a permission statement by the copyright holder, not a CC0 dedication." and "Do not relicense. Do not mark Newberry-derived data as CC0 or public domain." Extension (issue-3-source-map.md): the Rumsey/IA road and rail maps carry an explicit CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 string with a separate "contact … for commercial use" instruction; NGE text is fair-use-only for non-commercial purposes. None of these is CC0; treat all three regimes (Newberry BY-NC-SA 2.5 or "any lawful purpose", Rumsey BY-NC-SA 3.0, NGE non-commercial fair use) as incompatible with commercial distribution until written confirmation is obtained. Modern FIPS codes (US-GA-<fips>) are a crosswalk key only; FIPS codes did not exist in 1942.
